## s06-v10 — argument map

May limb-embrace-enjoyment with Thee happen to me by mere will (bhavadaṅgapariṣvaṅgasambhogaḥ svecchayaiva me). This much gained, what have I not won (ghaṭatām iyati prāpte kiṃ nātha na jitaṃ mayā)?

### Open
- Swamiji (Academy, ch6 v10): the devotee desires to embrace the Master 'just by my will,' because 'by Thy embrace I have conquered everything.'
